verdict.rationale: Pulley documents downloading the cap table as an Excel file, either as of a specific date or for all time, so the core ownership data can be taken out. Nothing shows a full account export, such as uploaded documents, signed agreements, stakeholder profiles, 409A reports or transaction history. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of programmatic bulk export. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export beyond the cap table, export of documents and agreements, open formats beyond Excel such as CSV or JSON, an API for bulk extraction, documented offboarding or portability guidance, and independent corroboration.
